The experience lasts about 5-15 minutes because of attacks, but their purpose of the game is to upgrade and you can upgrade about 6 things at a time. by the time you unlock the 4 builder each building takes 1 to 3 days. I have never had the game crash. However, it does require internet or Wi-Fi, I do not know which. I always get the two mixed up. there are no advertisements. You can buy items in the game with real world currency, but it is only cosmetics and basic loot, like coins.

Great, but don't bother paying. Any progression you pay for is just going to be undone when they catch F2P up, so you might as well get it for free rather than spending. Constant overpriced cosmetics are cool looking, but insane to think you'd pay $40+ to look pretty on a mobile game. I've supported a lot over the years because I love the game, but getting sick of their business practices.

I love this game. that said I have wasted so much money,time,resources. sped up the pace of play the amount I play the amount I buy to take advantage of all the earned ore weapons, skins etc while the special events are going on. there's so much ore i didn't receive books I didn't receive I literally went up 2 th's and spent like 100 to make up for all the items that I either didn't receive or went black until my level surpassed the chest/book and it said no longer available.

Still not a fan of ranked, make it a seperate trophy system and bring back the old Bronze-Champion type of system. Ranked is cool but If I want to hit titan I should be able to attack as much as I want in order to do so. This tournement style is kind of cool, but once again it needs to be its own style of system. I had like 3500k Trophies and now Im getting back into the game stuck in a "rank" with TH10s, of course Im going to steam roll them. Fix this!!

This game is a blast to play, especially with my clan. The game keeps getting updated, progression is assisted in many ways, the attacking system is always fresh, and it keeps me playing and gives me something to pass time. However, as a Jadon viewer and clan chatter myself, the dark screen glitch (look it up) is traumatizing me and making chatting near-impossible on PC. If this could just get fixed I'd have almost no issues with this game :D still very good overall

I love this game. The strategy and building your base are fulfilling, and there are so many strategies for fun attacks. I mean, I don't have to tell you it's a great game. My only complaint is the lack of different free items. It's been glowy ore every time and it's only 10. Ore in general needs work, especially the glowy and starry. Edit* adding new equipment that's good. I spend time and money on making it better just for you to nerf it is extremely aggravating and unfair. STOP DOING THAT.

This game has action, lore, and all in between which is why I love playing this game so much! it's a game with basic rules that makes it easy to pick up and play which makes the experience even more enjoyable! You get to explore different worlds, while battling difficult enemy kingdoms in a click to drop style! In conclusion I'd recommend anyone and everyone to play Crash of Clans! Thank You for listening!

it's alright, I guess. the visuals are pretty good and I like the multiplayer and the chat in the teams. the loading screen takes WAY too long, I'm on a time limit; hurry TF up 🙄. updating the app could be its own horror movie, it's an awful experience and takes way too long. at least there wasn't really any in-game ads. whenever I try to login or update it, my music always paused and it randomly lags. I know it's not my Internet/wifi.

Used to have a 5 star review here. But random disconnecting issues are so frustrating. when you lose connection during a battle, even if it's just because your device is switching networks, which mind does even when I have "good signal" i cannot reconnect to my attack even though the game knows it's "still going" because I can't start another. when this hop ends during Clan war or a ranked attack, it's really frustrating and there's not anything you can do about it. please fix!

This game is amazing, and I've been playing it since release. I've enjoyed it a lot over the years, but there's one issue during CWL (Clan War Leagues). My clan only has seven active members, so when CWL starts, we can't participate in regular wars and it reduces the amount of content we can enjoy. I think the game would be even better if regular clan wars could run alongside CWL, allowing smaller clans to keep playing and having fun during the CWL season.

This is my third account this game is so AWESOME!!!! Did not think this game could get any better than it did!!! Love tue new version. Tye ship was great idea. Things could always be better ( like making the giants turn and fight when they are being attacked by hero or troops from clan castle ) just a thought! This game is worth the time and never gets old. Always something to look forward too completing. If you have not tried, what are you waiting for. LOVE THIS GAME! CLASH FOREVER!!!!

This new catch-up mechanic just took a mightly bite out of the active player base. I shouldn't have to miss out on thousands of ores because I spent time and money upgrading my heros. I may have nearly maxed hero levels, but I still have over a year before I could have my equipment maxed if I kept up my same activity level (though that is only if there was no more equipment added). Supercell, please listen to the community and do something about this.

perfect game. on town hall 12 and so far I have no complaints. I do have a recommendation though. I wish there was a queue for upgrading stuff. it would start a new upgrade from the top of your requested list to the bottom. it wouldn't use resources until the upgrade actually starts so that way if you change your mind and want to switch you can. great game!

it's a very addicting, fun and engaging game that I love to play. I do not mind the upgrade wait times. it gives me something to look forward to. the only issue im having and the reason for the 4 stars is that the game keeps crashing every now and then. I'd get to the loading screen and then the moment I see my village, boom it closes me out. it infuriates me so much. I've cleared the cache, data and even uninstalled and reinstalled this game so many times. I don't wanna give up on this game.

Also the company is super greedy and poops on their high level loyal customers and showers new players in rewards and gifts. They only care about money and getting as much as possible from people, so why try and make loyal and long term customers happy when you can make new people paying customers?

Having played this game for 12 years, I figured I would give you all review. If I could add one feature to make this game top notch I would add the ability to have a view count on your profile for a given season. Given how much time and effort we put in, it would be nice to see how many people have viewed my base.. this would be the clashers equivalent of instagram(jk but kind of) even the ability to like a players base. To sum up, I feel like there are features that could better connect us<3

Absolutely love this game and I'm hooked! The only thing I want your developers to improve is the heroes upgrade. They are way too time-consuming and require a dedicated heart

I started playing Clash of Clans in 2016, and after all these years, the same frustrating issues still exist. Random connection errors and timeouts can happen even with a stable internet connection, causing attacks to be wasted—exactly what happened to me during a war attack. It's disappointing that such a major issue remains unresolved after a decade. Also, most modern multiplayer games have built-in voice chat, but Clash of Clans still doesn't. As a long-time player, this is really frustrating

When I return, my attack is often ruined, resulting in lost trophies, loot, and war performance. My internet connection is stable, and this issue has happened multiple times. Played this game like 4-5 years ago and just came back in 2026. There's definitely a lot going on now, it think. The game still works regularly just like how I remember it. Uh, good combat, upgrading system, rewarding system, animation, visuals and soundtracks. 5/5; quite a simple game, hard to earn victory in defenses but easy to gather resources.

I'll give them 4stars. I've been playing this game since I was in high school. Now I don't know why it is so easy to get disconnected to your attacks even if you have a strong signal. I suggest dev's can fix this that even if the signal gets disrupted for a second it can still reconnect to your attack. So disappointing, you just got disconnected only for a point of a second then your attack cannot be reconnected. In terms of war and cwl it's really awful

There was a time when I stopped playing for a few years, but somehow I always found my way back. That's what makes Clash of Clans special. It never loses its charm. Every time I return, there's something new to explore while the nostalgia remains the same. Building my village, fighting alongside my clan, and watching the game evolve over the years has been an amazing experience. Thank you, Supercell, for creating a game that keeps bringing players back, no matter how long they've been away.

Very enjoyable game but, I don't know why, in-game purchases says that "Transaction is pending" and is grey-ed out for many months now (from the start to be honest). It really is disturbing. Thanks a lot team, really great 🙏

I returned after a 1 year break and was disappointed by how little has changed. While there are new buildings, nothing feels truly new. I really dislike the decision to merge buildings, especially removing the Eagle Artillery. You should Instead, expand the base and add new buildings. After 10+ years, the game needs bigger changes maybe Revamp troops with new abilities, balance troops, and increase Army Camp capacity for more strategic attacks.

Clash of Clans is one of the best strategy games I have ever played. The game offers a perfect mix of village building, resource management, and exciting battles. I really enjoy participating in Clan Wars and Clan Games with friends. The developers continue to add new content and improvements, which keeps the game fresh and interesting. The graphics are great, the matchmaking is fair, and there are many ways to progress even without spending money. Highly recommended to anyone who loves strategy

I give it 5 stars on android but windows a 3 due to the consistent failure to install updates. But it has not improved. I can leave the upgrade running for 24 hours and it still does not complete successfully. So every time there is a major update, it takes me an hour to recover everything.

Clash of Clans is one of the few mobile games that has stayed fun for years. The base building, strategy, and Clan Wars keep the gameplay engaging, and the developers consistently add new content and improvements. While the upgrade times can get very long at higher levels, the game is still enjoyable without spending money if you're patient. Overall, it's a polished, well-supported strategy game that's easy to recommend.

At first, Clash of Clans looks simple if you don't know how to play. But once you start upgrading your Town Hall, buildings, troops, and defenses, you'll realize it's a highly strategic and engaging game. It's like playing chess in action form, where planning, timing, and precision are key to success. The reason I'm giving it 4 stars instead of 5 is because the wall upgrade costs seem much higher than most other building upgrades. It would be great if the developers could reduce the cost

Clash of Clans is an amazing strategy game that still stands at the top of its genre. It offers a perfect mix of base building, attacking strategies, and teamwork through clans. Regular updates and new events keep the game fresh and exciting. The graphics are simple yet appealing, and the gameplay is smooth. Features like Clan Wars and Clan Capital make teamwork even more fun and engaging. The best part is that even as a free-to-play game, you can still progress with skill and strategy.

The most recent Update, aside from beeing extremely buggy (do you test your Updates at all before you roll them out?), was very badly though out and punishes long time players in multiple ways. I've played Clash of Clans for years, but the reconnect system is unacceptable. If your connection drops for a few seconds during the attack countdown, your war attack is lost even if you never deploy a troop. Mobile connections aren't perfect, and brief interruptions happen. There should be a short reconnect window instead of an automatic 0-star attack. This has happened to me multiple times and it's enough to cost the game a 1-star review.

After a year of grinding, and buying gold/event passes, Supercell just released an update that invalidates most of the progress I achieved. New players get my current level of hero equipment progress for free, and can easily overtake me, while I get nothing and am still years away from maxing it out, despite playing actively every day and spending money on the game. For context, if I didn't focus on upgrading my heroes, I'd get 2,5k starry ores, which is ~1 year of progress.

Love this game! I enjoy strategically using different armies to raid bases and plan attacks.
